SET:U.meaning: integrated UUVs or weapon-carrying attack platforms

PARAM:P_ij.meaning: hit probability when platform/weapon resource i attacks target j; may be computed by the paper's motion/homing model or supplied as precomputed data

PARAM:c_i.meaning: weapon/resource cost of assigning one weapon from platform i

PARAM:S_i.meaning: maximum number of weapons platform i can fire / carry for the allocation task

PARAM:B_j.meaning: maximum number of weapons that may be assigned to target j to avoid waste/over-attack

PARAM:e_ij.meaning: range/feasibility indicator; 1 if target j is effectively within range of platform/weapon i, 0 otherwise

VAR:x_ij.meaning: 1 if platform/weapon resource i is allocated to target j, otherwise 0

OBJ:F1.meaning: battlefield residual target value after attack

OBJ:F2.meaning: battlefield residual target threat degree after attack

CON:C1.meaning: each target receives at least one and at most B_j assigned resources

CON:C3.meaning: assignment allowed only if the target is within effective range/feasible engagement condition

SEMANTIC:unsupported_single_residual_thr.meaning: single residual-threat scalar objective replacing three objectives

SEMANTIC:unsupported_weapon_target_compa.meaning: weapon-target compatibility matrix unrelated to range feasibility

SEMANTIC:unsupported_time_windows_or_sta.meaning: time windows or stages not in the target allocation model
